business_summary.text: CESC is an integrated power utility with distribution licences and franchisees across seven locations, about 2,140 MW of thermal generation and a renewables platform, Purvah Green, targeting 10 GW.

call_points.text: Committed renewable capex is put at ~₹26,000+ Cr, with annualised revenue of ~₹3,400+ Cr and EBITDA of ~₹3,000+ Cr.
Distribution investment of ₹6,000 Cr is planned to grow regulated equity and cut T&D losses.
Operating cash flow was ₹40 bn in FY26, up 57% YoY, against ~₹350 bn of capex planned over five years.
Kolkata T&D losses fell to 6.11% in FY26 from 6.5% in FY25, with revenue of ₹9,939 Cr.

penalties.authority: Regional Director, North Western Region,Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)
penalties.details: The MCA levied an aggregate penalty of Rs 5,91,000 on Bhadla Three Skp Green Venture Private Limited (Bhadla), a step down subsidiary of CESC Limited, and its officers in default, for delay in filing of e-form with the Registrar of Companies. Bhadla has complied with the Order by paying the said penalty amount within the timelimit and the matter stands resolved.

guidance.statement: Targets doubling of PAT from FY26 and 400 bps ROE expansion by 2030
Medium-term renewable capacity target of 10 GW, against 4.8 GWp contracted
Committed renewable capex of ~₹26,000+ Cr with annualised revenue of ~₹3,400+ Cr and EBITDA of ~₹3,000+ Cr
Distribution investment of ₹6,000 Cr and 3 GW solar cell line investment of ~₹3,000 Cr
~₹350 bn capex over the next five years

operating_notes.text: Contracted renewable capacity is 4.8 GWp plus 2.2 GWh BESS, of which 1.8 GWp is operational including 1,411 MWp under acquisition.
FY26 thermal PLFs: Haldia 95%, Crescent 92%, Budge Budge 82%, Chandrapur 83%, Southern 31%.
Kolkata T&D loss fell to 6.11% in FY26 from 6.5% in FY25; Malegaon DF loss was 36.33% against 39.7%.
